description: Change an affiliate's name, email, payout emails, notifications, campaign (moves them) or state. Setting state to disabled stops tracking and earning; set it back to active to undo. Rewardful: PUT /v1/affiliates/:id.

campaign_id.description: Campaign to put the affiliate in (default campaign if omitted on create).

paypal_email.description: PayPal address commissions should be paid to.

receive_new_commission_notifications.description: Email the affiliate when they earn a commission (default true).

state.description: Affiliate state. Disabled/suspicious affiliates stop tracking and earning and can't log in.

stripe_customer_id.description: Customer-referral programs only: the live-mode Stripe customer that receives account credits.

wise_email.description: Wise address commissions should be paid to.

name: rewardful_update_affiliate
title: Update an affiliate
